div.div: مَأْسُوكَةٌ A woman hit, hurt, or wounded, in her إِسْكَتَانِ: (TA:) a woman (Msb) hurt, or wounded, in a place not that of circumcision, by the circumcising woman's missing the proper place; (S Msb, K;) [i. e.,] hurt, or wounded, by that cause, in her إِسْكَتَانِ. (T, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
